# proxmox_query_url_metadata (Data Source)

Queries metadata of a download URL through `/nodes/{node}/query-url-metadata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_query_url_metadata" "m" {
  node = "pve-1"
  url  = "https://example.com/image.iso"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `url` (String)

### Optional

- `verify_certificates` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String)
- `mimetype` (String)
- `size` (Number)
